title: XCraft Survival | Mining Since 2013
description: XCraft Survival seeks to create and form new experiences for fans of old-school Minecraft. Since 2013, our mission has been to bring Minecraft servers back to their roots, with the classic Survival Gamemode.
body:
![XC-Top-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e8feb4bfdc3eb5073584b63ac9e8cf022c30c4c.png)

**XCraft Survival** is celebrating over **10 Years** of providing a nice escape! Since 2013, we've been working hard to create a server that allows you to play with ease. We're all about the old-school survival experience, with a few fun twists! From custom enchantments and tweaked crafting recipes to fighting Herobrine and using Flight Feathers, you'll find your niche!

## 📋 What is XCraft Survival?
We are a **play-to-win** server; the only way that you're going to get farther than anyone else is by putting in the work, which means **_NO P2W_**. Our ranks are purely cosmetic, letting you earn everything you have in-game with our Perks system. You can upgrade yourself to have more set homes, player vaults, portable workstations, and more!
